context_requirements: Functional GABAA receptor expression with appropriate subunit composition
Neuronal lineage or exogenous expression of GABA receptor subunits
For TSPO-mediated effects, high TSPO expression and a ligand that engages TSPO rather than GABAA receptors
falsifiers: Reproducible induction of canonical GABAergic immediate-early genes such as FOS, JUN, EGR1 or BDNF at 6 h in any of the nine lines
Consistent concentration-dependent transcriptional changes shared across multiple lines at 6 h or 24 h
Enrichment of GABA-receptor or TSPO-dependent gene signatures in the 978 landmark genes
